# Lefft

> Portfolio and publishing hub for Paddy Donnelly, an accomplished picture book author and illustrator specializing in children's literature with distinctive character design and storytelling.

Lefft showcases Paddy Donnelly's extensive body of work across picture books, book cover illustrations, and character design. The site serves as both a portfolio and resource for schools, publishers, and readers interested in contemporary children's literature and illustration.

## Key Topics

- Paddy Donnelly
- Picture books
- Children's illustration
- Character design
- Book cover illustration
- Author-illustrator
- The Vanishing Lake

- Irish children's books

## Core Portfolio

- [Paddy Donnelly](http://lefft.com): Homepage for Paddy Donnelly, picture book author and illustrator showcasing portfolio.
- [Books](http://lefft.com/books): Portfolio of Paddy Donnelly's published children's books and illustration work.
- [Illustration](http://lefft.com/illustration): Illustration portfolio featuring children's book artwork and character design.
- [About](http://lefft.com/about): Biography and background information about author-illustrator Paddy Donnelly.

## Picture Books

- [The Vanishing Lake](https://lefft.com/the-vanishing-lake): The Vanishing Lake debut picture book by Paddy Donnelly.
- [The Golden Hare](https://lefft.com/the-golden-hare): The Golden Hare picture book by Paddy Donnelly.
- [Here Be Giants](https://lefft.com/here-be-giants): Here Be Giants picture book illustrated by Paddy Donnelly.
- [Wolves In Helicopters](https://lefft.com/wolves-in-helicopters): Wolves In Helicopters bedtime picture book illustrated by Paddy Donnelly.
- [Fox & Son Tailers](https://lefft.com/fox-and-son-tailers): Fox & Son Tailers picture book by Paddy Donnelly and O'Brien Press.
- [Here Be Dragons](https://lefft.com/here-be-dragons): Here Be Dragons picture book illustrated by Paddy Donnelly.
- [Hom](https://lefft.com/hom): Hom picture book illustrated by Paddy Donnelly and Jeanne Willis.
- [Míp](https://lefft.com/mip): Míp Irish-language picture book illustrated by Paddy Donnelly.
- [Dodos Are Not Extinct](https://lefft.com/dodos-are-not-extinct): Dodos Are Not Extinct picture book illustrated by Paddy Donnelly.

## Book Cover Illustration

- [Twitch Series](https://lefft.com/twitch): Twitch series cover illustrations by Paddy Donnelly for M.G. Leonard.
- [The Lightning Catcher](https://lefft.com/lightning-catcher): The Lightning Catcher cover illustration by Paddy Donnelly.
- [Wonderscape](https://lefft.com/wonderscape): Wonderscape book cover illustrated by Paddy Donnelly for Jennifer Bell.
- [Orla And The Serpent's Curse](https://lefft.com/orla-and-the-serpents-curse): Orla And The Serpent's Curse cover illustration by Paddy Donnelly.
